Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Office Assistant post at Government Industrial Training Institute Kanchipuram is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant position is passing the 8th Standard. Additionally, candidates must have fluency in reading and writing Tamil and knowledge of riding a bicycle.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Office Assistant post ranges from Rs. 15700 to Rs. 50000 Per Month, falling under Level - 1.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age is 32 years for OC, 34 for BC/MBC/DNC, and 37 for SC/SCA/ST and Destitute Widows. Age relaxations are applicable for certain categories.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Office Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Office Assistant role will primarily involve Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Office Assistant post at Government Industrial Training Institute Kanchipuram.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Government Industrial Training Institute Kanchipuram, which is https://kancheepuram.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What are the important dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The important dates include the age as on 01 July 2026 and the last date for receipt of application, which is 30 September 2026.
